stories.text: ⚡ Early edge: Beautiful Dark Twisted Fantasy went from 31% to 71% against Kirbo Crushers, led by Egbuka (17.20 pts).
🗓️ Sunday's key matchup: TDsMaGee 54% vs The Mahomies. The Mahomies leads by 14.20 after TNF. Watch Daniels (20.80 pts) vs Chase (22.26 pts).
🔁 Trade that should have happened: Price and Williams for Andrews and Adams back in Week 1 would have helped both TDsMaGee and Claremont In Yo Stace!.
🗓️ Another tight one Sunday: 49er Faith-Fool 56% vs Mr. Action Jackson. Watch Taylor (19.33 pts) vs Jeanty (18.05 pts).
🪓 DEATH WATCH: Team Name leads the chopping-block odds at 36%, with Moose Knucklers next at 18%.
🎯 10 teams are in the thick of the median race, with Mr. Action Jackson right on the line (49%).
🪑 The one that got away (on the bench): TDsMaGee has yet to start RJ Harvey. Starting him in Weeks 1, 3 and 4 would have meant 2 more wins by now (+18.10 pts).
📉 STOCK WATCH: Kirbo Crushers' playoff odds cratered from 51% to 39%. Somebody check on the group chat.
📈 TRENDING: Every other league is scrambling for Dameon Pierce (RB, PHI). Ours has him sitting on waivers.
🧊 THIN ICE: The Mahomies has no healthy backup RB behind Love and Williams. One more injury and there's a hole in the lineup.
🗞️ Fresh off the wire: Gibb it to Me Baby added Jets D/ST (D/ST, projected 7.51 pts), plus 2 more pickups.
🎯 George Pickens is 15.60 pts above ESPN projection for Claremont In Yo Stace!.
📈 49er Faith-Fool was down to 16% against The Mahomies — and won.
